name: LONGi Hi-MO 5 Monocrystalline Solar Panel 545W
shortDescription: High-efficiency 545W monocrystalline panel with half-cut cell technology for maximum energy yield.
description: The LONGi Hi-MO 5 is a premium monocrystalline solar panel delivering 545W of power through advanced half-cut PERC cell technology. Designed for both residential and commercial installations, this panel offers industry-leading efficiency of 21.1% and excellent low-light performance. Its robust construction withstands harsh weather conditions including heavy snow loads up to 5400Pa and wind loads up to 2400Pa. The anti-reflective coating ensures optimal light absorption throughout the day, while the reinforced frame provides long-term structural integrity for decades of reliable energy production.

name: Canadian Solar HiKu6 Mono 550W
shortDescription: Top-tier 550W monocrystalline module with outstanding degradation resistance and 25-year linear warranty.
description: The Canadian Solar HiKu6 is a flagship monocrystalline solar panel that pushes the boundaries of residential and commercial solar energy. With 550W output and 21.3% module efficiency, it maximizes energy generation per square meter of roof space. The panel utilizes advanced n-type TOPCon cell technology for superior temperature performance and slower degradation over its lifetime. Canadian Solar's proven track record of bankability and quality makes this panel an excellent choice for homeowners and businesses seeking reliable long-term solar investment in the Romanian market.

name: JA Solar DeepBlue 3.0 Mono 460W
shortDescription: Versatile 460W monocrystalline panel ideal for residential rooftop installations with excellent value.
description: The JA Solar DeepBlue 3.0 delivers exceptional value with its 460W monocrystalline design optimized for residential installations. Featuring half-cut PERC cells and multi-busbar technology, this panel achieves 20.7% efficiency while maintaining a compact footprint suitable for most Romanian rooftops. The panel's enhanced hot-spot resistance and PID-free construction ensure worry-free operation for decades. With its competitive pricing and strong performance metrics, the DeepBlue 3.0 is one of the most popular choices among Romanian homeowners transitioning to solar energy.

name: Trina Solar Vertex S+ Mono 440W
shortDescription: Compact high-power 440W panel with innovative Vertex cell technology for space-constrained rooftops.
description: The Trina Solar Vertex S+ is engineered for residential rooftops where space optimization is critical. Delivering 440W from a compact form factor, this monocrystalline panel features Trina's proprietary 210mm cell platform with non-destructive cutting technology. The result is higher power density per square meter, allowing homeowners to generate more electricity from limited roof space. Its excellent low-irradiance performance makes it particularly well-suited for Romanian climates, ensuring consistent energy production even during cloudy winter months.

name: Canadian Solar KuPower Polycrystalline 340W
shortDescription: Reliable and affordable 340W polycrystalline panel, perfect for budget-conscious large-scale installations.
description: The Canadian Solar KuPower is a dependable polycrystalline solar panel that offers excellent performance at an affordable price point. With 340W output and 17.5% efficiency, it remains a solid choice for budget-conscious projects and large-scale ground-mount installations where roof space is not a constraint. The polycrystalline cells provide consistent energy production with proven long-term reliability. Backed by Canadian Solar's 25-year linear performance warranty and 12-year product warranty, the KuPower series continues to be a trusted option for cost-effective solar energy systems across Romania.

name: Trina Solar Honey Polycrystalline 310W
shortDescription: Cost-effective 310W polycrystalline panel with proven field performance and robust build quality.
description: The Trina Solar Honey series polycrystalline panel delivers 310W of dependable solar power at one of the most competitive price points on the Romanian market. Engineered with Trina's multi-busbar cell interconnection technology, this panel minimizes resistive losses while improving shade tolerance compared to standard polycrystalline designs. Its IP68-rated junction box and reinforced anodized aluminum frame ensure durability in Romania's diverse climate conditions, from hot summers to heavy winter snowfall. Ideal for agricultural installations, carports, and residential projects where cost per watt is the primary consideration.

name: Huawei SUN2000-5KTL-M1 Hybrid Inverter 5kW
shortDescription: Smart hybrid inverter with battery-ready design, integrated AFCI protection, and FusionSolar monitoring.
description: The Huawei SUN2000-5KTL-M1 is a state-of-the-art hybrid inverter designed for modern residential solar systems in Romania. With 5kW capacity and 98.6% peak efficiency, it seamlessly manages solar generation, battery storage, grid export, and household consumption. The integrated Arc Fault Circuit Interrupter (AFCI) provides an extra layer of fire safety, while the built-in AI-powered optimizer ensures maximum energy harvest from each panel. Compatible with Huawei's LUNA2000 battery system, this inverter enables full energy independence and smart prosumer management under Romania's net-metering regulations. The FusionSolar app delivers real-time monitoring and control from your smartphone.

name: Growatt MIN 6000TL-X String Inverter 6kW
shortDescription: High-performance 6kW string inverter with dual MPPT and built-in Wi-Fi for affordable solar systems.
description: The Growatt MIN 6000TL-X is an excellent string inverter for residential solar installations seeking high performance without the premium price of hybrid models. Delivering 6kW of AC output with 98.4% peak efficiency, this inverter features dual MPPT trackers for flexible panel configuration on roofs with multiple orientations. The built-in Wi-Fi module connects to Growatt's ShinePhone monitoring platform, providing real-time production data and historical analytics. Its compact, lightweight design with integrated DC disconnect simplifies installation. The MIN series has become one of the most popular inverter choices among Romanian solar installers due to its reliability and competitive pricing.

name: BYD Battery-Box Premium HVS 5.1 kWh
shortDescription: Modular high-voltage lithium-ion battery with cobalt-free LFP technology and 10-year warranty.
description: The BYD Battery-Box Premium HVS 5.1 kWh is a cutting-edge lithium iron phosphate (LFP) energy storage system designed for residential solar installations. Its modular design allows expansion from 5.1 kWh up to 12.8 kWh by stacking additional battery modules, making it perfect for growing energy needs. The cobalt-free LFP chemistry ensures superior safety, longer cycle life (over 6000 cycles), and environmentally responsible manufacturing. Compatible with leading hybrid inverters from Huawei, SMA, and Fronius, the BYD HVS integrates seamlessly into any Romanian prosumer solar system. The high-voltage architecture (204-358V) minimizes conversion losses for maximum round-trip efficiency of 95.3%.

name: Huawei LUNA2000-10-S0 Smart Battery 10 kWh
shortDescription: Smart 10 kWh lithium-ion battery with built-in optimizer, expandable up to 30 kWh for full energy autonomy.
description: The Huawei LUNA2000-10-S0 is a premium smart energy storage solution that pairs perfectly with Huawei SUN2000 hybrid inverters for a fully integrated solar ecosystem. With 10 kWh usable capacity and the ability to scale up to 30 kWh with additional modules, it provides substantial energy autonomy for Romanian households. Each battery module includes a built-in power optimizer that enables independent module management and enhanced safety through real-time monitoring. The LFP cell chemistry delivers over 6000 charge cycles while maintaining 70% capacity, translating to approximately 16 years of daily cycling. The seamless integration with Huawei's FusionSolar platform allows intelligent charge and discharge scheduling based on electricity tariffs and consumption patterns.

name: K2 Systems SingleRail Roof Mount Kit
shortDescription: Universal pitched roof mounting system with adjustable clamps for 6 solar panels on tile or metal roofs.
description: The K2 Systems SingleRail Roof Mount Kit provides a professional-grade mounting solution for residential rooftop solar installations in Romania. Engineered for pitched roofs with tile or metal sheet coverings, this complete kit includes all necessary rails, mid-clamps, end-clamps, and roof hooks to securely mount up to 6 solar panels. The single-rail design reduces material usage and installation time by up to 30% compared to dual-rail systems, while maintaining full structural integrity. All components are manufactured from corrosion-resistant anodized aluminum and stainless steel, ensuring decades of maintenance-free service. The adjustable hook system accommodates various roof tile profiles commonly found across Romanian residential buildings.

name: K2 Systems FreeField Ground Mount System
shortDescription: Adjustable ground-mount racking system for 8 panels with 15-30 degree tilt angle optimization.
description: The K2 Systems FreeField Ground Mount System is a versatile and robust racking solution designed for ground-mounted solar installations on open land, gardens, or agricultural properties across Romania. This complete kit supports up to 8 solar panels in a landscape configuration with an adjustable tilt angle between 15 and 30 degrees, allowing installers to optimize the array angle for Romania's latitude (approximately 44-48°N). The hot-dip galvanized steel construction provides exceptional corrosion resistance and structural durability for a 25+ year lifespan. The system includes ground screws for foundation-free installation, preserving the land for future use. Ideal for properties where roof mounting is not feasible or for maximizing system size beyond available roof space.
